important_source_behaviors: constructor primes the first child; cursor does not recreate/replay its generator
rewind after advancing a nonempty iterator fails, invalid current/key fail; failed rewind can retain current but lose key; empty cursors may rewind repeatedly
render writes root before rewinding; even empty root writes a line; no extra trailing blank line
has_children probes a fresh child iterator and get_children creates another; callbacks may run twice with changing results
only child probing/child cursor construction errors are swallowed by default CATCH_GET_CHILD behavior; next-item prefetch errors propagate with partial output

whole-render visited identity is global, so DAG object reuse also raises Cycle; visited strong node references avoid allocator-address reuse false positives; current/tail retained until iterator/helper release
numeric string keys use existing weak scalar coercion, rejected nonnumeric/overflow keys still leave the rendered root line
style factory creates a section only for directly wrapped real ConsoleOutput identity, preserving capture/section/wrapped/error output and newline counter boundaries
rust_adaptations: source TreeHelper.next maps to advance: source method only advances, whereas std Iterator.next returns an element; Clippy exposed actual ambiguity; no lint exemption or compatibility alias added
source RecursiveIterator protocol maps to explicit cursor methods plus native borrowed IntoIterator/TreeIterator adapters; no PHP/SPL runtime dependency or invented fully implemented global SPL type
helper and child helper exclusively borrow selected output; exact E0499 Rustdoc negative example; end child scope before reusing parent
static preset prefixes and shared immutable custom strings avoid per-depth deep copies; no measured speedup asserted
node data ownership remains Arc/Weak with explicit strong-cycle cleanup per previous unit; final iterator tail retention added based on actual source WeakReference observations
PHP precision-loss deprecation diagnostics are not a Rust engine channel; key probes run source error_reporting=0, results/errors/output actually compared; scalar rules reuse EnumBacking
boundaries: arbitrary third-party OutputInterface / ConsoleOutputInterface and Artisan.call third argument remain a separately tracked open contract; current Tree SDK accepts current AsOutput-backed outputs
full component Factory and remaining Artisan tutorial anchors stay open
